tasks.title: Review/Why/Me memory loop + ModelPort and XMemo MemoryPort adapters
tasks.goal: Accept/adjust/dismiss with Why on every plan; feedback creates pending MemoryFact proposals applied only on confirm; Me shows confirmed/pending/rejected facts and daily prompt budget. ModelPort (Muse Spark) does schema-validated, fact-checked wording with deterministic fallback; MemoryPort writes back confirmed facts only (local adapter default per HB-3).
checks: Playwright: dismiss-with-reason and adjust create pending proposals; preferences unchanged until confirm in Me; rejected proposals remain queryable (AC-105-2, AC-105-3, INV-107)
Playwright reload check: after reload, confirmed facts, pending proposals, same-day suppressions and the used prompt-budget count are unchanged (AC-105-4, INV-110)
ModelPort unit tests: output containing an unlisted time or place is discarded for the deterministic template; model disabled/timeout leaves D1-D6 outputs identical (AC-106-1, AC-106-2)
Static check: no API key or token literal in client code; MemoryPort write-back rejects non-confirmed facts (AC-106-3, HB-2)
